event_segments_n_no_risk.description: Generic event-compressed no-risk exact backend for arity 1 and 3..10.

event_segments_n_tp_sl_15m_grid.description: Generic event-compressed TP/SL backend backed by hit_times/15m.

streaming_2_no_risk.description: Specialized 2-indicator streaming fallback for parity/perf comparison.

direction_semantics.long_only: +1 opens/holds long; 0 or -1 closes an open long; short trades are never opened.
direction_semantics.long_short_reversal: +1 opens/holds long; -1 opens/holds short; opposite direction closes and reverses.

methodology.measurement: Measured totals exclude sample_warmup_s and use rows_per_indicator=6 full Cartesian workload.
methodology.warmup: Each measured run is preceded by a sample warmup on min(2, rows_per_indicator) rows per indicator for the same arity, risk mode, direction mode, and backend. Full dry-run warmup is intentionally not used.
